subject: Production transition readout and post-deploy smoke checklist
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Hart <alice.hart@clarionhealth.com>, ops@clarionhealth.com
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Production transition readout and post-deploy smoke checklist

Alice / Clarion ops team —

Thanks for the coordinated cutover window yesterday evening. Per our plan, Redwood routed the private deployment into Clarion's VPC and completed the initial traffic handoff at 21:04 PST. This thread is a short readout + consolidated smoke checklist so we have a single source of truth for outstanding validation items and next steps.

Summary (high level):
- Network peering and egress rules: complete; a pair of intermittent NAT timeouts were observed (see note 3).
- Certs & mTLS: edge certs rotated; internal service certs still pending rollover for svc-kv01.
- Model serving: all endpoints registered in the service registry; primary pool at 8 GPUs available.
- Observability: token-level traces and cost tagging enabled; a telemetry lag spike at 20:48 (likely batch backlog).

Action items we own (Redwood):
1) Provide the post-deploy smoke log bundle and a short runbook excerpt for Clarion's on-call (attached).
2) Triage NAT timeouts with the Clarion infra team and share packet-level traces.
3) Complete svc-kv01 cert rollover before Friday 1200 PST.

Clarion asks (from call):
- Confirm fallback policy in case Dedicated pool hits saturation during tomorrow's load test.
- Verify retention window for request logs (they requested 90 days vs our default 30).

I'll attach the smoke checklist and a condensed runbook excerpt to the follow-up. Please flag anything missing or incorrect.

Thanks —
Dylan
Director, Customer Solutions
Redwood Inference

[attachment: private_deploy_runbook_v3.md (text/md)]

From: Alice Hart <alice.hart@clarionhealth.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@clarionhealth.com, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 10:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Production transition readout and post-deploy smoke checklist

Dylan —

Appreciate the quick summary. Clarion ops confirmed the NAT timeouts; we saw ~18 drop events between 20:45–21:05. We're attaching our packet-capture and will hand over a temporary route fix to avoid recurrence during tomorrow's daytime traffic test.

Two clarifications:
- Retention: we can accept 90 days if we agree to the delta-price for logging storage — we need the formal quote before we sign off.
- Fallback: we need a documented automatic fallback (priority: maintain availability; degrade to 1/2 token throughput rather than returning 429s). Can Redwood confirm the exact model variant that will be used for the fallback path?

We'll expect the detailed smoke bundle and the runbook snippet from you.

—Alice
Head of Infra, Clarion Health

[attachment: clarion_packet_20261201.pcap (pcap)]

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 08:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Production transition readout and post-deploy smoke checklist

Looping internal owners and adding a short internal runbook note for actionability.

Quick internal notes:
- NAT timeouts: initial hypothesis is an ephemeral SNAT port shortage on Clarion's NAT gateway under the short spike of parallel model warmups. Ask Clarion to confirm ephemeral port utilization graph; in parallel we can stage a temporary egress proxy to reduce port churn.
- svc-kv01 cert rollover: I've staged the new cert in the private store; plan to push during the 03:00–03:15 UTC maintenance window (Fri). Laura, will you pair on rollout?
- Fallback policy: Redwood's automatic fallback will use model variant rdx-small-v2 (quantized) with a maintained per-token latency SLO; behavior is to buffer up to 50 concurrent requests and queue beyond that, then shed low-priority traffic with 503s (we can alter to 429s if Clarion prefers). Need final sign-off.

I'll prepare the smoke bundle (logs + traces + a short readme) and a one-page runbook for Clarion's on-call.

- Dev
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference

[attachment: internal_runbook_snippet.txt (text/plain)]

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Hart <alice.hart@clarionhealth.com>, ops@clarionhealth.com
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 4 Dec 2026 07:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Production transition readout and post-deploy smoke checklist

Alice / team —

Attached is the smoke bundle from the evening handoff and a brief validation matrix. Highlights from our verification run (completed 2026-12-04 23:05 PST):
- End-to-end request success rate: 99.88% (3000 synthetic requests, mixed prompt sizes).
- Median p50 latency: 142ms; p95: 640ms (excursions aligned with short batch backlogs at 20:48).
- NAT drop correlation: packet-capture shows SYN retries from worker pool to external telemetry endpoint; Clarion's temp route fix removed the retried path.
- svc-kv01 cert rollover scheduled (Dev & Laura) for 2026-12-05 03:10 UTC.

Attachments: prod_smoke_report_20261205.pdf (summary + raw traces), network-trace-20261205.tar.gz (pcaps, tcpdump snippets), private_deploy_runbook_v3.md (runbook excerpt & rollback steps).

Open items (we need confirmation):
1) Clarion confirmation on fallback variant: rdx-small-v2 (quantized) — default to this unless we hear otherwise by EOD 2026-12-05 PST.
2) Logging retention quote acceptance so we can update billing and the logging retention toggle.

If you want, we can schedule a 30-minute readout tomorrow after the cert rollover to validate end-to-end.

Thanks —
Dylan

[attachment: prod_smoke_report_20261205.pdf (pdf)]

From: Alice Hart <alice.hart@clarionhealth.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@clarionhealth.com, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 5 Dec 2026 17:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Production transition readout and post-deploy smoke checklist

Dylan / Redwood team —

Confirmed: the svc-kv01 rollover was successful in the Fri 03:10 UTC window; Clarion ops reports no auth failures after the change. We ran a daytime load validation at 16:00 PST (2k mixed requests) and saw the following:
- Service availability: 99.9%
- Fallback exercises: we intentionally toggled Redwood to use rdx-small-v2 for 20 minutes; degradation behavior matched our expectation (graceful throughput reduction with surge queues, only low-priority background jobs received 503s).

We accept the fallback variant as documented. On logging retention: procurement is reviewing the delta quote; expect final sign-off by next Tues.

Great work on the runbook and the quick turnaround on NAT traces — attaching a short ops note we added to Clarion's incident binder. Happy to formalize this as the "production-transition acceptance" once procurement signs the retention addendum.

—Alice
Head of Infra, Clarion Health

[attachment: clarion_ops_note_20261205.txt (text/plain)]
